AI Engineer (Generative AI / Agentic AI)

Leading MNC

Bangalore

Hybrid (3 Days Work from Office)

8 yrs to 15Years




Job Summary




We are looking for a highly skilled AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, modern AI frameworks, vector databases, prompt engineering, and enterprise API integrations. This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI solutions in a collaborative engineering environment.





Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and deploy enterprise Generative AI applications.
Develop LLM-powered applications using Python.
Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
Design AI agents using Agentic AI frameworks.
Develop prompt engineering strategies for enterprise use cases.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise APIs, databases, and external systems.
Work with vector databases for semantic search and knowledge retrieval.
Evaluate, monitor, and optimize AI model performance.
Deploy scalable, production-ready AI applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and product teams
